title: Networking and API Integration
description: Learn how to connect your React Native apps to web services and APIs using fetch and Axios. Understand GET/POST requests, async data handling, and error management.

lessons.title: What is Networking in React Native?
lessons.content: Networking in React Native refers to communicating with external services or APIs to send or retrieve data. This is commonly done using the `fetch()` function or libraries like `axios`.

lessons.title: Using Fetch for GET Requests
Making POST Requests
Using Axios for Simpler Networking
lessons.content:
```bash
npm install axios
```
```jsx
import axios from 'axios';

axios.get('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1')
  .then(response => console.log(response.data));
```

lessons.title: Handling Errors in Network Calls
Using Async/Await with Fetch
Loading States and UX
lessons.content: Always show feedback (like a spinner or message) when loading data. This improves user experience and helps users know something is happening in the background.

lessons.title: Working with FlatList and API Data
Sending Form Data via API
Best Practices for Networking
lessons.content:
- Always handle loading and error states
- Use async/await for cleaner code
- Keep API URLs in a separate config file
- Validate user input before sending
- Consider libraries like Axios or React Query for larger apps
